detailed_descriptions.en: In the mood for a story? The Creep has picked these out just for you... Creepshow is a collection of twisted, self-contained tales where the humor is dark, and the endings are… not what you expected. Each story drops you into a nightmare with new characters, new horrors, and a fate that you won’t see coming. Follow Danny and his friends as a bad day at the mall turns into something much, much worse. Their search for the truth of what happened to Danny’s father turns dark as they uncover sinister secrets. Fate brings Danny to The Reader, a mysterious fortune-teller, who has a taste for treacherous tales. Expect pulp-inspired visuals, a tone that plays up the camp without losing its wit, and endings that hit hard. The horror here isn't just trying to scare you... It's about enjoying the whole thing a little too much. All the thrills and chills you expect from Shudder's Creepshow Play through one overarching narrative, with two additional self-contained stories Stylized comic-book environments with horror mini-games throughout each story

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
In the mood for a story? The Creep has picked these out just for you...

Creepshow is a collection of twisted, self-contained tales where the humor is dark, and the endings are… not what you expected. Each story drops you into a nightmare with new characters, new horrors, and a fate that you won’t see coming.

Follow Danny and his friends as a bad day at the mall turns into something much, much worse. 

Their search for the truth of what happened to Danny’s father turns dark as they uncover sinister secrets. 

Fate brings Danny to The Reader, a mysterious fortune-teller, who has a taste for treacherous tales.

Expect pulp-inspired visuals, a tone that plays up the camp without losing its wit, and endings that hit hard. The horror here isn't just trying to scare you... It's about enjoying the whole thing a little too much.

  • All the thrills and chills you expect from Shudder's Creepshow

  • Play through one overarching narrative, with two additional self-contained stories

  • Stylized comic-book environments with horror mini-games throughout each story
